data.one_liner: Provides iOS‑style Liquid Glass widgets with Material 3 fallbacks for Android.
data.what_it_does: Offers adaptive glass‑effect UI components that render native iOS liquid glass on iOS 26+ and Material 3 surfaces on Android. The API is platform‑agnostic, so no branching is required.
use_when: You need iOS‑styled glass UI that matches SwiftUI on iOS 26+
You want a single API that automatically falls back to Material 3 on Android
avoid_when: You target platforms other than iOS or Android (e.g., web, desktop)
You require highly custom glass shaders beyond the provided presets
strengths: Pixel‑accurate iOS liquid glass verified against SwiftUI
Single adaptive API, no platform checks needed
weaknesses: Initial frame may show a plain blur before shaders load
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency and optionally call AdaptiveLiquidGlass.initialize() before runApp()

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broad set of cross‑platform widgets without glass‑specific effects
